parameters.name: UserConfirm
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to fix the blocking status of the cluster. Valid values:

*   true: yes
*   false: no

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas modify-cluster-cnnf-status-user-confirm --cluster-ids cf55f3bd2bad747858c6a5f2101ad0000 --user-confirm true --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ModifyClusterCnnfStatusUserConfirm --region cn-hangzhou --ClusterIds.1 cf55f3bd2bad747858c6a5f2101ad0000 --UserConfirm true
